annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于转发生态环境部等部门《群众身边水体保护治理行动方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Forwarding the Action Plan for Protection and Treatment of Water Bodies Near the Public by the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and Other Departments
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
annotation.summary_en: State Council General Office notice forwarding a multi-ministry action plan to protect and treat water bodies near residents, targeting industrial park pollution, black-odorous waters, livestock waste and rural rivers by 2030. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2030, basically eliminate black-odorous water bodies in counties and townships
Rectification campaigns for industrial parks, livestock manure and rural water bodies
Expand monitoring networks and digital enforcement
Revise water quality and discharge standards
Local governments bear primary responsibility with fiscal and social capital support
